name: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Limited

facts.business: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Limited is an EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) company focused on renewable energy projects, also providing operation and maintenance services.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: (i) Note 56 - write off and impairment of investment in a wholly owned subsidiary, loans given along with accrued interest and other receivables due to unfavorable arbitration outcome, uncertainty surrounding projected cash flows of a contract of the wholly owned subsidiary and evaluation of projected cash flows, presented as exceptional item. (ii) Note 54 - Indemnity Agreement dated December 29, 2021 with Promoter Selling Shareholders and Reliance New Energy Limited for indemnification and reimbursement for net amount on settlement of liquidated damages pertaining to certain identified past and existing projects, old receivables, direct and indirect tax litigations and certain legal and regulatory matters if claims exceed INR 300.00 crores.

key_risks: Impairment of investment in wholly owned subsidiary due to unfavorable arbitration outcome and uncertainty surrounding projected cash flows
Dependence on promoter indemnity for claims exceeding INR 300 crores related to liquidated damages, old receivables, tax litigations and legal/regulatory matters
Concentration risk: Revenue from two customers accounts for more than 10% of total revenue (INR 3,018.29 crore in FY 2025-26)
Geographic concentration: India represents approximately 97.20% of net revenues
facts.related_party_note: An omnibus approval was obtained from the Audit Committee for related party transactions that are repetitive in nature and these transactions were conducted at arm's length and in the ordinary course of business. During the year, the Company did not enter into any related party transactions that were considered 'material' in accordance with its Policy on Materiality of Related Party Transactions. There were no transactions undertaken during the financial year under review that were not on an arm's length basis; accordingly, the disclosure under Form AOC-2 is not applicable. Indemnity Agreement dated December 29, 2021 entered into by the Company with Shapoorji Pallonji and Company Private Limited, Khurshed Yazdi Daruvala (jointly the 'Promoter Selling Shareholders') and Reliance New Energy Limited pursuant to which the Promoter Selling Shareholders would indemnify and reimburse the Company and its subsidiaries/branches for a net amount on settlement of liquidated damages pertaining to certain identified past and existing projects, old receivables, direct and indirect tax litigations as well as certain legal and regulatory matters, if such claims (net of receivables) exceeds INR 300.00 crores.
